name: help hearing
stdout:
usage: airpods hearing [-h] {status,aid,media-assist,recover,profile} ...

Hearing Aid and Media Assist change how sound is presented, including how loud
it is. They have not been verified on real AirPods. See docs/CLI.md.

positional arguments:
  {status,aid,media-assist,recover,profile}
    status              read the modes; writes nothing
    aid                 turn Hearing Aid on or off
    media-assist        turn Media Assist on or off
    recover             after an unconfirmed change: read the modes, and with
                        --off turn one off
    profile             show the stored hearing profile, or apply a new one

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
